data.name: Page Blocks Classification
data.abstract: The problem consists of classifying all the blocks of the page layout of a document that has been detected by a segmentation process.

variables.name: p_black
variables.description: Percentage of black pixels within the block (blackpix / area)

variables.name: p_and
variables.description: Percentage of black pixels after the application of the Run Length Smoothing Algorithm (RLSA) (blackand / area)

variables.name: mean_tr
variables.description: Mean number of white-black transitions (blackpix / wb_trans)

variables.name: blackpix
variables.description: Total number of black pixels in the original bitmap of the block

variables.name: blackand
variables.description: Total number of black pixels in the bitmap of the block after the RLSA

variables.name: wb_trans
variables.description: Number of white-black transitions in the original bitmap of the block

additional_info.summary: The 5473 examples comes from 54 distinct documents. Each observation concerns one block. All attributes are numeric. Data are in a format readable by C4.5.
